# IDOpenTech Launchpad

> IDOpenTech Launchpad is a verified Solana Private Sale Launchpad. It allows Solana wallet holders with a verified balance of at least 2 SOL to participate in whitelist allocations for next-generation Solana tokens.

## Domain & Platform Endpoints

- **Main Platform**: https://launchpad.idopentech.com/
- **Cyrus ($CRS) Private Sale**: https://launchpad.idopentech.com/cyrus
- **Intyfe ($INTYFE) Private Sale**: https://launchpad.idopentech.com/intyfe
- **EV-GO ($EVGO) Private Sale**: https://launchpad.idopentech.com/evgo

## Active Projects & Private Sales

### 1. Cyrus ($CRS)
- **Token Name**: Cyrus
- **Symbol**: CRS
- **Network**: Solana Mainnet
- **Private Sale Price**: 0.015 SOL per CRS
- **Total Supply**: 3,000,000,000 CRS
- **Token Sale Allocation**: 1,350,000,000 CRS (45%)
- **Hard Cap**: 20,250,000 SOL
- **Min / Max Commitment**: 100 SOL – 5,000 SOL
- **Official Links**:

## Verification & Eligibility Requirements

- **Wallet Connection**: Connect a supported Solana Web3 wallet (Phantom, Solflare, Backpack, etc.).
- **Eligibility Threshold**: Wallet MUST hold at least **2 SOL** to unlock registration forms.
- **Settlement**: All commitments are settled directly in SOL. Live SOL USD/USDC prices are provided for reference.
